mentionsLegales1: You are currently connected to the website of the collaborative application digiwall.app created by La Digitale.
mentionsLegales2: Digiwall is a collaborative application that allows you to create multimedia walls that can contain all types of files and interactive media. Its use is exclusively reserved for educational and pedagogical purposes.
mentionsLegales3: La Digitale declines all responsibility for the content published by users of the site. La Digitale undertakes to remove, after notification by e-mail, any content that is inappropriate or that does not respect copyright.
mentionsLegales4: The collection of personal data is limited to the logs automatically generated by the server. La Digitale will not transmit or resell user data to third parties. This site is not subject to any traffic monitoring for statistical purposes.
mentionsLegales5: A cookie containing the identifier of the user and a cookie containing the identifier of the communication socket are used to allow the connection to the user session and the update in real time of the contents of the walls. To ensure a maximum level of confidentiality, it is recommended to use a pseudonym and not to indicate personal information in the contents.
mentionsLegales6: The site is hosted by the company Infomaniak (www.infomaniak.com/fr), Geneva, Switzerland.
